report.full.helpBody.en: This report displays all persistent data of a live class session in one place: actual timing and duration, student attendance, participant list, saved chat, speaker-attributed speech transcript, live polls, reactions, and recording status. Interactive artifacts are only saved when closed by the host using "End Session".
